messages:
maria: FYI demand spike in EU, ~80 H100s gap for next quarter. need vendor lead-time, RMA pool, and customs cadence.
alex_vendor: hi all  factory can do 2x weekly departures. sea ETA 5-7w, air consolidated 10-14 days. refurb/RMA throughput limited to 12 units/week. air premium ~ $950 per GPU (estimate) plus possible peak surcharges.
ryan: ops check  can we accept mixed pallets (new + refurb)? firmware mismatch risk.
lucy_ops: prefer separate manifests. we'll quarantine refurbs to staging-rma and run 72h thermal soak + 48h burn-in before joining prod. adds ~6 engineer-days per 20-unit batch.
alex_vendor: we can split manifests. will mark refurbished units on CI and include HS code 8471.60 and buyer-signed CI for air. can provide provisional AWBs once shipments booked.
sre-bot: NOTE: last 60d thermal warnings in eu-staging: +2.7% over baseline. recommend extra soak for RMA cohort.
maria: quick ROI thought  missing launch costs ~$55k/week. air for first 40 units ~ $38k45k, sea delay 6w -> big revenue hit. need formal calc.
ryan: dev plan: reserve 30 GPUs for critical latency services, stagger installs to avoid capacity cliffs. kubectl steps fine for cordon/drain.
lucy_ops: action list: 1) Alex: per-shipment ETA + tentative AWB (24h). 2) Maria: authorize PO split if ROI supports (EOD). 3) Ryan: prepare gating doc for reserve & rollout (2h). 4) Ops: publish RMA burn-in checklist (today). reconvene after AWBs.
alex_vendor: will send ETAs/AWBs tonight. can provision split billing to show refurb discount for customs to smooth clearance.
maria: agreed. prefer air-first 40 new units, refurbs consolidate by sea. sign-off pending ROI.
sre-bot: ALERT: tag #incidents if thermal events >5% during soak.
